official_text:

official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education, upon recommendation of the Measures N and H Commission, of a 2024-2025 Education Improvement Plan/Budget modification for Envision Academy to reduce $40,921.97 Strategic Carryover by $539.00 to $40,382.97 and establish a new strategic action $539.00 Equipment: Funds to purchase 35 Logitech MK120 Desktop Corded Keyboard & Mouse Combos, as stated in the justification section of the New or Revised Strategic Action Section of the Budget Modification Form
presenter: Measures N and H - College and Career Readiness Commission
headline: Moves $539 at Envision Academy to buy 35 keyboard and mouse combos
summary: This changes Envision Academy's 2024-25 spending plan under Measures N and H (Oakland's voter-approved college and career readiness funds). It cuts the strategic carryover line from $40,921.97 to $40,382.97 and creates a $539 equipment line for 35 Logitech MK120 corded keyboard and mouse combos. The money moves within the school's existing plan.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

group: Measures N and H Commission - June 3, 2025 - David Kakishiba, Chairperson
title: Measures N and H Commission - Leadership Public School Oakland R&D - 2024-2025 Plan/Budget Modification
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education, upon recommendation of the Measures N and H Commission, of a 2024-2025 Education Improvement Plan/Budget modification for Leadership Public School to the following two line items: (1) reduce $3,500.00 Equipment for Media Studio by $3,500.00 to $0.00 (2) reduce $2,500.00 PD and Coaching for Art and Design Teacher by $2,500.00 to $0.00, and establish a new strategic action to increase $15,000.00 General Consulting: Partnership with REEL Oakland by $6,000.00 to $21,000.00, as stated in the justification section of the New or Revised Strategic Action Section of the Budget Modification Form
presenter: Measures N and H - College and Career Readiness Commission
headline: Moves $6,000 at Leadership Public School Oakland R&D to raise its REEL Oakland partnership to $21,000
summary: This changes Leadership Public School Oakland R&D's 2024-25 spending plan under Measures N and H (Oakland's voter-approved college and career readiness funds). It removes the $3,500 media studio equipment line and the $2,500 art and design teacher coaching line, and raises the general consulting line for a partnership with REEL Oakland from $15,000 to $21,000. The money moves within the school's existing plan.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

group: Measures N and H Commission - June 3, 2025 - David Kakishiba, Chairperson
title: Measures N and H Commission - Leadership Public School Oakland R&D - 2024-2025 Plan/Budget Modification
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education, upon recommendation of the Measures N and H Commission, of a 2024-2025 Education Improvement Plan/Budget modification for Leadership Public School Oakland R&D to reduce $15,000.00 Internship and Apprenticeship Stipends by $12,500.00 to $2,500.00and establish a new strategic action $12,500.00 Travel and Conference, as stated in the justification section of the New or Revised Strategic Action Section of the Budget Modification Form.
presenter: Measures N and H - College and Career Readiness Commission
headline: Moves $12,500 from internship stipends to travel and conferences at Leadership Public School Oakland R&D
summary: The Board is asked to approve a change to this school's 2024-2025 improvement plan and budget, recommended by the Measures N and H Commission. Internship and apprenticeship stipends would be cut from $15,000 to $2,500, and a new $12,500 travel and conference item would be created. The text describes a shift between budget lines, not new spending.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Alternative Design-Builder – C. Overaa & Company – Coliseum College Preparatory Academy Site Expansion Project– Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Award of Agreement Between Owner and Alternative Design-Builder Contract by and between the District and C. Overaa & Company, Richmond, CA., to provide additional redesign and development services, which include the preparation of preliminary schematic diagrams for classroom breakout spaces that meet the 960-square-foot code requirements for the Coliseum College Preparatory Academy Site Expansion Project, in an additional amount of $295,520.00, increasing Agreement’s total not-to-exceed amount from $2,882,578.00 to $3,178,098.00,  and extending the term of the Agreement from August 29, 2024, through September 30, 2027 to December 6, 2027, (an additional 67 days). All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $295,520 to C. Overaa & Company's Coliseum College Prep expansion design-build contract
summary: This amendment pays for added redesign work, including early drawings for classroom breakout spaces that meet the 960-square-foot code requirement at Coliseum College Preparatory Academy. It raises the contract's not-to-exceed total from $2,882,578 to $3,178,098 and extends the end date by 67 days, to December 6, 2027. All other terms stay the same.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Agreement for Inspector of Record Services for Construction – Anthonio, Inc. – McClymonds High School Modernization Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of an Inspector of Record Services Agreement by and between the District and Anthonio, Inc., Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide Inspector of Record Services for Construction for the McClymonds High School Modernization Project, in the not-to-exceed amount of $705,408.00, which includes a not-to-exceed amount for Additional Services of $64,128.00, with work scheduled to commence on June 12, 2025, and scheduled to last until June 30, 2027.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Hires Anthonio, Inc. for up to $705,408 in construction inspection at McClymonds High School
summary: Anthonio, Inc. would provide inspector of record services during construction of the McClymonds High School Modernization Project. The not-to-exceed amount is $705,408, which includes up to $64,128 for additional services. Work is scheduled from June 12, 2025, to June 30, 2027.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: General Services Agreement Valley Relocation and Storage of Northern California, Inc. - Coliseum College Preparatory Academy Site Expansion Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

headline: Pays Valley Relocation and Storage up to $8,283 to move three classrooms to Lockwood STEAM Academy

vendor_name: Valley Relocation and Storage of Northern California, Inc.
schools: Coliseum College Preparatory Academy; Lockwood STEAM Academy

title: Amendment No. 1, Agreement for Inspector of Record Services - King Construction Inspection, Inc. - Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Agreement for Inspector of Record Services for Construction  by and between the District and King Construction Inspection, Inc., Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide additional professional services, which consist of added Scope for Fire Alarm and Intrusion testing, as outlined in the Proposal dated March 21, 2025, which is attached to this Amendment as Exhibit A, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, for the Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project, in an additional amount of $55,823.20, increasing the Agreement’s total not-to-exceed amount from $72,742.99, to $128,566.19.  All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $55,823 to King Construction Inspection's Roosevelt Middle School contract for fire alarm testing
summary: This amendment adds fire alarm and intrusion alarm testing to King Construction Inspection, Inc.'s inspector of record work on the Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project. It raises the contract's not-to-exceed total from $72,742.99 to $128,566.19. All other terms stay the same.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
